payload.name: Store explicit counts for sets of owned entities
payload.description: When construction extracts a new member of an existing set of entities owned by a person (e.g., pets, children, vehicles), store the updated total count explicitly in the profile or state memory.
content: If a message introduces a new instance of a category the person already has (e.g., another pet, child, car), after recording the new instance also update or create a memory stating the total number of that category, e.g., 'Person has N X.'
When updating an existing memory that lists members of a set, ensure the explicit count is included in the updated content and not left implicit.

solves: The diagnosed cause is that extraction stored individual dog adoptions but never recorded the running total, so a later count query could only infer the number from listed names. The rule generalizes the mechanism of maintaining explicit set-size in memory whenever a new member is added. It applies to any future conversation where a person's countable possessions or family members grow over multiple sessions, so that count-based questions are answerable without re-inferring from names.
